INSERT INTO trades ( trade_ref, instrument_id, counterparty_id, asset_class, side, quantity, price, trade_date, status ) SELECT 'TRD-2026-' || LPAD(gs::text, 6, '0'),
i.id,
((gs - 1) % 10) + 1,
i.asset_class,
CASE WHEN random() < 0.5 THEN 'BUY' ELSE 'SELL' END,
ROUND((100 + random() * 9900)::numeric,4),
ROUND((20 + random() * 980)::numeric,4),
DATE '2026-04-01' + floor(random()*120)::int,
CASE WHEN random() < 0.70 THEN 'MATCHED' WHEN random() < 0.82 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN random() < 0.94 THEN 'UNMATCHED' ELSE 'DISPUTED' END
FROM generate_series(1,500) gs
JOIN ( SELECT id, asset_class, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) rn FROM instruments ) i ON i.rn = ((gs - 1) % (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instruments)) + 1;

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO recon_breaks (trade_id, job_id, discrepancy_type, status) SELECT id, 'seed-job-001', (ARRAY[ 'PRICE_MISMATCH', 'QUANTITY_MISMATCH', 'DATE_MISMATCH' ])[1 + (id % 3)], 'OPEN' FROM trades WHERE status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED') LIMIT 30;
